tools.name: get_chapter_background
tools.description: Summary and historical background of a Bible chapter (66-book Protestant canon), with key original-language words and places when available. Cite the returned URL.

tools.name: lookup_word
tools.description: Look up a Hebrew or Greek lexeme by lemma, transliteration, Strong's id (H430, G2378) or Korean/English gloss. Returns gloss, part of speech and occurrence counts.

tools.name: lookup_place
tools.description: Look up a biblical place by Korean/English name: location (lat/lon), type, passages, with Pleiades/OpenBible/Wikidata sources.

tools.name: lookup_person
tools.description: Look up a biblical person by Korean/English name: mention counts, main books, short description.

tools.name: search_dictionary
tools.description: Search the Bible dictionary (500 Korean entries adapted from Easton's Bible Dictionary, public domain) by term or keyword.
